authority: Research consolidation only. docs/canonical/** remains the normative source; this file cannot resolve open decisions or approve production use.
rules: adoption_decision is a research recommendation; approved_dependency=true only when npm_package is in product/package.json.
Kafka, Redis-backed queues and Temporal are not introduced without an approved measured need; PostgreSQL remains the ingestion/idempotency authority.
No asset may own canonical commercial semantics (I-10/I-11) or widen lead-scoped access (I-09).

assets.name: Nango
assets.rationale: OAuth connection lifecycle and credential isolation patterns are useful, but ELv2 hosted-service limits, a second runtime and token custody outside our PostgreSQL boundary outweigh benefit for one provider. Keep a narrow ConnectionPort.
assets.architecture_fit: Modular monolith (NestJS + Fastify) with PostgreSQL as the single durable store; no Kafka/Redis/Temporal unless a measured need is approved.
assets.revisit_trigger: Second concrete OAuth provider in PH4+ with refresh/revocation races that the narrow port cannot cover.

assets.name: Airbyte
assets.rationale: Analytical replication is not the LVP need; interactive handoff semantics and lead-scoped access are. Reference cursor/state/backfill design for ads reporting sync.
assets.architecture_fit: Modular monolith (NestJS + Fastify) with PostgreSQL as the single durable store; no Kafka/Redis/Temporal unless a measured need is approved.
assets.revisit_trigger: Validated need for bulk analytical replication of ads/CRM data.

assets.name: BullMQ
assets.rationale: ADAPT idempotent job id, deduplication, rate-limit and backoff patterns into a PostgreSQL-backed job/outbox table first. Redis adds a second durable store; BullMQ dedup is not exactly-once commercial ingestion.
assets.architecture_fit: Modular monolith (NestJS + Fastify) with PostgreSQL as the single durable store; no Kafka/Redis/Temporal unless a measured need is approved.
assets.revisit_trigger: Measured job throughput/latency the PostgreSQL queue cannot sustain.

assets.name: Temporal
assets.rationale: Premature: cluster operations, determinism constraints and a second persistence layer for a pilot-scale monolith. Revisit only for proven long-running cross-system compensation.

assets.revisit_trigger: Multi-step provider compensations spanning hours/days with human approvals that simple jobs cannot model safely.
